fusions.name: Folded Dart
fusions.desc: Throws a folded tine that deals 4 damage, then skips on to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Final Clause
fusions.desc: Consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to this blow, which deals 18 damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Posted Notice
fusions.desc: Every ally within 6 tiles strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Margin Notes
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
